common.disclaimer: Field guidance, not a licence to prescribe. The bottle label and the livestock office win. Sudden death with blood from the nose, foot and mouth, and a shed of dead birds: report them. Do not open the carcass.

diagnose.title: Read the case
diagnose.pick: What are you standing in front of?
diagnose.signs: Tick only what you can see
diagnose.none: No strong match. Open emergency, or describe it in words on the home search.
diagnose.examCrop: Walk the field before you tick
diagnose.cropSteps: Pattern of the patch, then young leaves, old leaves, stem base, fruit or ear, insects on a white paper.
diagnose.animalSteps: Appetite and cud, ears hot or cold, breath, left flank, eyelid colour, mouth and feet, udder, how many others are sick.

voice.download: Download and transcribe on this phone
voice.never: Audio is not uploaded. Export is the only way a file leaves the phone, and only if you tap it.
voice.oneSpeaker: One speaker at a time. We do not separate voices.
voice.dialectNote: The hint is from words, not a judgement and not a trained accent test.

tools.title: Field arithmetic
tools.label: The label on the bottle overrides this card.
tools.straw: Straw if green is short, about
tools.estimate: Estimate, often off by 15 percent. A scale is better.
tools.either: Use SOP or MOP, not both.
tools.customHint: Only if a vet already wrote milligrams per kilogram and the bottle says milligrams per millilitre. This is not an antibiotic dose.
tools.mgkg: mg per kg, from the prescription
tools.mgml: mg per ml, from the bottle
